Real-world analogies making complex health concepts relatable for everyone
When to Worry / Don't Worry guidance — reducing health anxiety from lab results
Visual emoji icons for at-a-glance parameter identification
Seasonal and circadian timing notes (e.g., cortisol peaks at 6-8 AM)
Decade-by-decade age-specific notes (20s through 70+)
Real-world clinical scenarios with teaching points
Trend interpretation — what rising or falling values mean over time
Differential diagnosis patterns for medical professionals (premium)
Drug interaction details with mechanisms (premium)

LOINC and ICD-10 medical codes for interoperability (premium)
